issue.title: Live Mermaid Highlights PDF test intermittently renders zero diagrams in the full CLI suite
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-k3.6.1.2, note #3, during owner album catalog sync verification. Its full `just check` CLI target failed `highlights::diagrams::highlights_create_live_mermaid_pdf_is_highlights_safe` with `rendered 0 of 4 Mermaid diagrams`; the same node passed in isolation on the phase tree and on clean master. The phase also reported a BOB_DIR unused-vault isolation diagnostic. Preserve that as an observed companion symptom, not a proven explanation for the rendering failure.

The test is at tests/cli/highlights/diagrams.rs:912. It requires uv, pandoc, xelatex, pdftotext, pdffonts, pdfimages and a discovered browser, then uses a long Unicode/spaced TMPDIR and expects three successful diagrams plus one deliberate invalid-diagram fallback. Investigate full-suite renderer contention, adapter diagnostics and subprocess environment isolation; preserve the three-success/one-fallback and PDF safety assertions. Capture the failing stderr/adapter result and compare unchanged-tree serial and parallel runs before choosing a remedy.

Evidence is the phase's audited note, not a fresh runtime reproduction by this lander. Reported observations: one full-suite failure, followed by isolated passes on the phase tree and clean master; exact aggregate rate and serial reproducibility are not yet established. Album changes do not modify the test, renderer, or adapter. The current lander reviewed the source on ae6a28d0 and all active epic scopes, with no causal active epic found. Same-type and all-type searches plus the recent all-status sweep found no duplicate. Closed bob-cli-9i fixed raw-PDF text fallback without pdftotext and is a distinct defect; this live test already requires pdftotext.

Size large because the failure mechanism is unconfirmed and needs a bounded diagnostic plan before implementation. Keep this outside bob-cli-k3.6.1.
